blocked_candidates.reason: The named Regional State Administrative Agency ceased operating on 1 January 2026; the Finnish Supervisory Agency inherited relevant functions. The archived source names the former body and supplies no historical date for a faithful dated question. Preserve the candidate and request source correction rather than teaching an obsolete contact.

The archived male-conscription age range of 18-60 is outdated: current Conscription Act section 2 sets an upper limit of 65, subject to transitional provisions. The source has no historical date for that range. General service duties are covered separately, but this specific age-range claim needs source correction.

scope_notes: Fixed formula and cutoffs; no percentage quota or collection-wide recalibration.

A question may cover repeated statements; a statement listing several important rights may need joint coverage. Coverage links describe the central learning claims, not a promise to ask every incidental detail.
Existing questions cover general non-discrimination across protected grounds rather than generating separate paraphrases for each ground or setting.
The citizenship EU-rights sentence has two distinct new learning points: electoral participation and work access.
Care duties and child voice, sexual autonomy and consent, and capacity-based access to abortion and contraception are consolidated across repetitions.
No source or unrequested assessment is edited to resolve stale facts. The two blocked candidates retain CORE scores.
No official exam-coverage guidance was used; relevance judgments are editorial estimates, not guaranteed exam questions.
